messages:
talia: Kickoff for SparkField AuroraS perf/W sweep + kernel tuning. Primary goals: map perf/W across VOLT bins, validate 4-bit quant path, and produce a short ops playbook for marketplace image. Notes: https://go/redwood/partnerships/sparkfield-auroras

ben: Sounds good. Proposed stages: quick calibration (single board), canary (1 board), cluster sweep (n=4), then regression soak. Dry-run Thurs 08:30 PT.

yuki: We saw VRM oscillation at high sustained sequences in earlier tests. For sweep, lock fan profile to partner-reco and capture VRM temps + per-rail current.

sparkfield-eng: We'll ship two instrumented AuroraS boards and a firmware candidate (auroras-v1.0.3-vrm). Firmware: s3://sparkfield/auroras/fw/v1.0.3/sha256=ffee1122. Also attaching BIOS knobs and bench wrapper.

bench-bot: automated: tag artifacts with run_id and bench_tag. Template: run_id=spark-<YYYYMMDD>-auroras-<board> bench_tag=spark-auroras-v1. Include firmware_sha and reservation_id in metadata.

talia: Metrics to capture: power.sample=0.5s, gpu_power, package_temp, vrm_temp, memory_bw, p99 latency, throughput (batch=1 & batch=16). Perf counters: L2_MISS, LLC_REFERENCES, IPC.

ben: Run both kernels: upstream-stock + sparkfield-prefetch-tune. A/B to isolate kernel effects. Keep model pinned to redwood/llama-7b@v1.3-quant for parity.

yuki: Traffic profile: 12% prefix hits, poisson arrival. Offline batch steady-state batch=16. For synthetic run use seq mix: 32/128/512 with weights 0.5/0.3/0.2.

sparkfield-eng: Board serials uploaded: s3://sparkfield/auroras/boards/serials.csv. Firmware sha: sha256=ffee1122. We'll canary on one board first.

talia: Action list: infra-svc reserve capacity; sparkfield-eng upload fw & serials; yuki publish perf script; ben publish manifest with kernel commits and bench_tag. I'll draft the marketplace blurb after artifacts look clean.

infra-svc: reservation created: rsv-2026-11-03-spark-4boards (link). Please include rsv id in run metadata.

yuki: Perf snippet: ```bash
# collect sensors + perf counters
./collect_telemetry.sh --sample 0.5 --out ./artifacts/spark-telemetry.json
perf stat -e L2_MISSES,LLC_REFERENCES,IPC -o ./artifacts/spark-perf.txt -- ./run_bench.sh --model llama-7b --seq 512 --iter 30
```

bench-bot: scheduled dry-run: Thu 08:30 PT. Calendar invites sent. Remember to tag artifacts using bench-bot template.

ben: Canary Fri 09:00 PT; full sweep Sat 00:30 PT (overnight). If canary passes we'll mark artifacts "partner-ready" and proceed to co-author the marketplace blurb highlighting perf/W delta and methodology.

sparkfield-eng: We'll be on-call for canary and happy to co-author the blurb if results look good.

talia: Great. Post any blockers here (firmware issues, thermal alarms, infra conflicts).
